merge_examples.text: In Kyiv, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy authorized raising the nationwide air-defence posture immediately.
In Kyiv, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy authorized temporarily reallocating mobile air-defense assets to high-risk southern sectors of Ukraine.
In Kyiv, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy authorized the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) and the Main Intelligence Directorate (GUR) to begin joint forensic debris recovery.
President Volodymyr Zelenskyy authorized immediate implementation of adviser Podolyak's recommendation that the SBU and GUR nominate liaisons to the Ukrainian Ministry of Defence.
António Guterres at UN Headquarters in New York endorsed the proposed agenda to renew the Black Sea grain agreement.
